bio.text: Bryan King, a Republican, represents Arkansas Senate District 28, which includes Carroll and Madison counties and parts of Boone, Franklin, Johnson and Newton counties.
He served in the Senate from 2013 to 2018 and was elected to a second stint in 2022.
King was elected to the Arkansas House of Representatives in 2006, serving three consecutive terms, and is a former election commissioner.
He is a farmer and owner of Triple K Farms in Green Forest, and was born in Springdale.
